_comment: Point BRIDGE_CONFIG at a copy of this file. Secrets never live here: they come from the
environment only. Any key can be overridden by its BRIDGE_* variable (see bridge.py).
service_map: platform project id OR project name -> the service name your traces use.
label_allowlist: the ONLY fields that may become labels; everything else rides inside the line.
sample_rates: errors, fatals and crashes are always kept regardless of these.
